releases.name: Omeglecode 0.4.0
releases.body: Shows the current room in the sidebar and adds clickable invite and make-invite actions.

releases.name: Omeglecode 0.3.1
releases.body: Fixes upgrades from older cached Omeglecode versions.

releases.name: Omeglecode 0.3.0
releases.body: Adds `/omegle-connect`, `/omegle-invite`, `/omegle-nickname`, and `/omegle-toggle`. Install with `npx --yes opencode-omeglecode@latest install`.

releases.name: Omeglecode 0.2.0
releases.body: First public test release. Install OpenCode v2, then run `npx --yes opencode-omeglecode@latest your-room-code`.
